▾ Where the time went                                                      b
  the 10,000-token prompt's traced request (under the profiler), from its
  GPU trace (ms)
  GPU kernels (their union)                                          1,344.4
    dense matrix multiplies                                            329.2
    expert matrix multiplies                                           304.4
    elementwise kernels (norms, type conversion)                       227.0
    attention                                                          118.6
    recurrent layers                                                   118.6
    other kernels                                                      103.7
    expert routing and combine                                          88.5
    copies and gathers                                                  54.4
  copies with no kernel running                                        261.3
    Host-to-GPU, pinned host memory, queue 15 (607.5 ms in all)        239.6
    GPU-to-GPU, GPU memory, queue 16 (21.5 ms in all)                   21.5
    Host-to-GPU, pinned host memory, queue 14 (9.7 ms in all)            9.7
    GPU-to-host, GPU memory, queue 14 (8.4 ms in all)                    8.4
    15 smaller copies                                                    0.6
  GPU idle (no kernel, no copy)                                        163.5
    CPU work (no GPU API call in flight)                               158.4
    a copy call the host waits in                                        0.2
    the host waiting for the GPU (synchronize)                           0.1
    8,820 short gaps under 1 ms each                                     4.8
  host time outside the GPU work                                        97.3
  not accounted for                                                      0.0
  ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  wall time of the traced request (under the profiler)               1,866.5
  The GPU work fits inside the request's wall time; the host time is what is
  left of the wall, so the parts add up to it by how they are counted.
  Of the GPU idle time, CPU work (no GPU API call in flight) took 158.4 ms;
  a copy call the host waits in took 0.2 ms; the host waiting for the GPU
  (synchronize) took 0.1 ms; 4.8 ms is in 8,820 short gaps under 1 ms each.
  Kernel time by family: dense matrix multiplies 329.2 ms, expert matrix
  multiplies 304.4 ms, elementwise kernels (norms, type conversion) 227.0
  ms, attention 118.6 ms, recurrent layers 118.6 ms, other kernels 103.7 ms,
  expert routing and combine 88.5 ms, copies and gathers 54.4 ms.
  Host-to-GPU copies from pinned host memory on GPU queue 15: 17.42 GB in
  607.5 ms (28.7 GB/s), 239.6 ms with no kernel running.
  GPU-to-GPU copies from GPU memory on GPU queue 16: 17.84 GB in 21.5 ms
  (831.6 GB/s), 21.5 ms with no kernel running.
  Host-to-GPU copies from pinned host memory on GPU queue 14: 0.24 GB in 9.7
  ms (24.9 GB/s), 9.7 ms with no kernel running.
  GPU-to-host copies from GPU memory on GPU queue 14: 0.24 GB in 8.4 ms
  (28.3 GB/s), 8.4 ms with no kernel running.
  Copies on different GPU queues overlap each other, so their times with no
  kernel running add up to more than the copy total.
  A GPU queue (a stream) runs its work in order; copies and kernels on
  different queues can overlap. Pinned host memory is locked in RAM, so the
  GPU reads it directly; ordinary (pageable) memory is first staged through
  a pinned buffer.
